# Tool catalogue

Every package this repository can install, and what it is for.

**Generated by `script/tools`; do not edit.** The descriptions are the purpose comments
in `profiles/*.Brewfile`, which is where they belong — one place to change, and
`tests/render-brewfile.sh` already refuses an entry that has none. `script/tools
--check` fails when this file no longer matches the declarations, so it cannot drift.

Kind matters for review: a `formula` is normally a single binary, while a `cask`
installs an application that may carry a background component, a system extension or
its own updater. ADR-013 and ADR-015 weigh those differently.

Installed by `./bootstrap install` with no `--profiles` argument.

## Totals

| | Packages |
|---|---|
| Default selection | 70 |
| Everything declared | 121 |

Language runtimes are not here: Node, Go, Java, Rust and pnpm come from mise
and Python from uv, so they are declared in `chezmoi/dot_config/mise/`
rather than as Homebrew packages (ADR-021).
